dataset_description: Synthetic technical-work benchmark for Hippocampus v1. Covers exact recall, paraphrase, temporal questions, cross-session synthesis, changed facts, contradiction, source attribution, and unanswerable queries across GitHub, terminal, browser, Slack, Linear, and files.
